During the early days of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tol Braga]] enlisted the aid of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] to help him and the other members of his [[Jedi strike team (capture of the Sith Emperor)|strike team]] in their quest to capture the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. On [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], the Hero and Jedi Master [[Warren Sedoru]] worked with the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] and the [[Balmorran resistance]] to recover a copy of the [[prototype cloaking device]] that shielded the [[Emperor's Fortress]]. After rescuing Master Braga's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and former [[Dark Council]]or [[Sajar]] from the [[Emperor's Wrath]] Lord [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]], the Hero traveled to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and searched for the schematics for the space station with the help of [[Leeha Narezz]] and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]] of the [[301st Infantry]]. The campaign would ultimately end in disaster when the strike team was defeated and turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] by the Emperor aboard his fortress.
